name: Hard Techno
summary: Short distorted 4/4 kick with a sidechained rumble tail that pumps on the offbeats, sharp offbeat hi-hats kept under 70% velocity, a 909 ride in loud/soft 8ths and schranz-style compressed percussion loops; snares are optional and often off 2 and 4. Energy moves through sudden drop-outs and re-entries rather than long builds, the offbeat double-kick gallop and three-bar polymeters add drive, and swing is zero.

sounds.kick: Short, pitch-enveloped, hard-clipped kick (909 or LinnDrum plus sine sub, or Jomox analogue) with the rumble built as a parallel reverb+distortion return low-passed at 150 Hz and sidechained; mono below 150 Hz.
sounds.snare: Noise-synth or 909 snare on 2 and 4 for the industrial lane, 808 snare pitched down an octave for offbeat 16th placements, tuned 909 rims at bar starts, huge stacked rave claps for call-and-response rolls.
sounds.hats: 909 closed hat (often resampled 12-bit through an SP-1200) low-passed with drive and never above 70%, compressed 909 open hat on the offbeats, 909 ride high-passed above 1 kHz and sidechained to the kick.
sounds.percussion: Compressed, filtered 16th rim/conga/clave loops (schranz), bitcrushed low toms ducked around the kick, metallic clanks and found sound, high-passed shakers, Simmons/909 toms for cascades.
sounds.cymbals: One crash on the drop; the ride is a groove element, not a wash.

machines: Roland TR-909 — kick base layer, snare, rim, closed/open hat, ride (owned)
LinnDrum — heavily compressed/overdriven kick in Attack's Thumping Techno dissection (owned)
Roland TR-808 — snare pitched down an octave, low tom for bitcrushing (owned)
E-mu SP-1200 — 12-bit resampling of 909 hats and toms for industrial grit (owned)
Jomox Xbase09 / Mbase01 — analogue punchy kick with pitch sweep; I Hate Models used a Jomox Xbase 999 (owned)
Elektron Machinedrum / Korg Electribe ER-1 — synthesised metallic percussion and hats for schranz loops (owned)
Roland TR-727 / TR-505 — congas and claves to filter and compress into loops (owned)
Novation Drumstation / Quasimidi 309 — period rave claps and 909-style kicks (owned)
Simmons SDS — synthetic toms for cascade risers (owned)
Sonic Academy Kick 2 — synthesised main kick most 2020s producers design from scratch (get elsewhere)
references: Sara Landry — Lord of the Land (2022)
Marco Leckbert — Schranz Will Never Die (2024)
